description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A unique token generated by the client to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token can contain up to 64 ASCII characters and must be unique across requests.

description.zh: 请求体参数，用来指定管道信息，更多详细信息请参见[logstash.yml](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/logstash/6.7/logstash-settings-file.html)。
description.en: The request body parameters that specify the pipeline information. For more information, see [logstash.yml](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/logstash/6.7/logstash-settings-file.html).

description.zh: 管道批延迟。单位：毫秒，默认值：50。
description.en: The batch delay of the pipeline. Unit: milliseconds. Default value: 50.
The batch size of the pipeline. Default value: 125.

description.zh: 队列检查点写入数。默认值：1024。
description.en: The number of checkpoint writes for the queue. Default value: 1024.

description.zh: 队列的总容量（以字节数表示）。单位：MB，默认值：1024。
description.en: The total capacity of the queue in bytes. Unit: MB. Default value: 1024.

description.zh:
队列类型。可选值：
- MEMORY：基于内存的传统队列。
- PERSISTED：基于磁盘的ACKed队列（持久队列）。
description.en:
The queue type. Valid values:
- MEMORY: a traditional memory-based queue.
- PERSISTED: a disk-based ACKed queue (persistent queue).

description.zh: 管道工作线程数。默认值：实例的CPU核数。
description.en: The number of worker threads for the pipeline. Default value: the number of CPU cores of the instance.

description.zh:
是否保存并部署管道。可选值：

- true：保存并部署
- false（默认）：仅保存
description.en:
Specifies whether to save and deploy the pipeline. Valid values:

- true: Save and deploy.
- false (default): Save only.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch create-pipelines --instance-id ls-cn-oew1qbgl0000 --trigger false --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --biz-body queueMaxBytes=1024 description=this_is_a_test queueType=MEMORY queueCheckPointWrites=1024 batchDelay=50 batchSize=125 config=input_filter_output workers=2 pipelineId=pipeline-test --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
